grader.scenario: Mobile roaming data not connecting in Valencia, Spain despite Roam-Further bolt-on being active
grader.notes: All-PASS excellent mobile roaming support call with natural STT disfluencies. Includes three hard-case PASS items: late-but-valid security verification at [03:37] (just under 240s), legitimate post-reprovisioning status re-check at [06:46] vs [01:30], and benign use of 'obviously' at [03:55].

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Opened with 'thank you for calling S-Net' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' at [10:47].

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Maintained continuous interactive troubleshooting with zero dead-air gaps over 30s.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Hard-case PASS: After initial triage of the airport roaming failure, Agent verified the customer's four-digit security PIN and home address at [03:37], just inside the 240-second verification window.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Used customer name 'Kwame' naturally throughout the call (e.g., [00:16], [03:55], [10:47]).

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Expressed warm empathy for Kwame being stranded at Valencia airport without mobile data at [00:16].

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Paraphrased the roaming data issue despite the active Roam-Further pass and confirmed understanding at [00:36].

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Hard-case PASS: Agent asked for carrier name and signal bars at [01:30] and re-asked at [06:46] only after removing the HLR GPRS bar, updating the APN to mob.s-net.co.uk, and switching networks to Orange ES—a legitimate post-fix status verification.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Took complete ownership of removing the stale HLR GPRS bar on both Kwame's line ([05:10]) and his partner's family-plan line ([08:57]).

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Hard-case PASS: Agent used a brisk, matter-of-fact pace and used the word 'obviously' in a polite, helpful sense at [03:55] ('Obviously I'll check that roaming carrier profile on our switch right now for you, Kwame').

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Probed systematically into handset model ([01:19]), carrier/signal indicator ([01:30]), Data Roaming toggle ([01:51]), dual-SIM/eSIM status ([02:13]), welcome SMS ([02:33]), and APN string ([05:42]).

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Confirmed live 5G connectivity on Orange ES, tested hotel voucher download and Google Maps ([07:25]), and confirmed full resolution at [10:43].
